title: Daily Combo

risk.label: Risk
risk.hint: Higher risk brings lower-probability, higher-odds picks.

pick.bttsFirstHalf: Both teams score in first half
pick.bttsNo: At least one team fails to score

error: Could not load, please try again shortly.
empty: No upcoming match with a ready analysis today. Analyses are prepared about 3 hours before kickoff.
noPick: No suitable match at this risk level.
edgeHint: Edge = probability × odds − 1. If negative, the odds are low relative to the model's probability.
history: Historically, when the model said {{band}}, it hit {{rate}} ({{n}} matches).
historyNone: No evaluated matches yet for this probability band.
targetUnreachable: The target odds cannot be reached with these settings; the highest is ≈ {{max}}.
disclaimer: Odds are approximate market odds from international bookmakers, not those of any Turkish operator. Nothing is guaranteed.
stakeInvalid: Amount must be above 0; amount × multiplier at most 10,000,000 TL.
targetInvalid: Odds must be above 1 and at most 1000.
relaxedNote: The odds you want are not reachable at the {{risk}}% threshold, so the minimum probability was lowered to {{used}}%.

advice.label: Suggested type
advice.fewLegs: Few matches: a straight combo is enough.
advice.lowRisk: Low risk: a single combo is simpler.
advice.smallStake: Small amount: a system multiplies the total stake.
advice.highRisk: High risk and many matches: a system tolerates one miss.

systemSummary.anyHit: Probability at least one combination hits
systemSummary.hint: Each combination is played with the full amount; total stake = number of combinations × amount.

needOdds: All matches need odds for the summary; some are missing.
systemLimit: A system allows at most 8 matches.
misliInvalid: Multiplier must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
manualIntro: Enter your risk, amount and the odds you want; we suggest a pick from the day's analysed matches. Matches are assumed independent.

presets.insufficient: Not enough data for this day.
presets.testData: Test data · national match, limited data
presets.label: Suggestion type
presets.fairHint: Fair odds = 1 / probability. If the price on your site is higher, the pick has value by the model; if lower, it does not.
presets.minLegsNote: Some matches may not be selectable alone or with few other matches on your site.
presets.method: Probability blends the AI model with the probability implied by international prices (margin removed); on past data the model alone is weak, so the price-implied probability weighs more.
